items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex off 400 pts from day's low; Nifty above 23,300
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap 100 and the Nifty SmallCap fell 1.42 per cent and 1.40 per cent, respectively

items.title: Paytm soars 4% in weak market, nears new high; stock up 90% from March low
items.description: Jefferies raises Paytm's earnings estimates for FY28-29 by 20-25 per cent to factor in 25bps MDR on UPI and raises the price target to ₹2,100 (from ₹1,600).

items.title: Havells, KEI: W&C stocks fall up to 16% in one week post UltraTech's entry
items.description: Mayank Jain of Share.Market by PhonePe flags key support and resistance levels for wires & cables stocks - Polycab, Havells India and KEI amid market correction post UltraTech's 'Ultravolt' launch.

items.title: Shankesh Jewellers bucks market sell-off to zoom 18% as Q1 PAT doubles
items.description: Shankesh Jewellers delivered strong financial performance in Q1, with revenue growing 55 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹424 crore. Its PAT stood at ₹43, reflecting an increase of 100 per cent on a Y-o-Y basis.

items.title: BSE shares down 3% today; is it the NSE IPO impact? What expert says
items.description: Analysts attribute some selling in BSE shares seen today to NSE's IPO. They said as NSE edges closer to market debut, BSE would not remain the only listed player.

items.title: Cement shares under pressure; ACC, Ambuja, Shree Cement crack to 52-wk lows
items.description: UltraTech Cement, Dalmia Bharat, JK Cement and India Cements were down between 1 per cent and 3 per cent in Friday's intra-day deals.

items.title: Oil, yields surge batter bank stocks; Nifty Bank index sinks 1.3%
items.description: Oil prices spiked to near $110 a barrel, on track to end the week at over $100 a barrel for the first time ​since mid-May.

items.title: Market crash explained: Sensex dives 700 pts intraday; Nifty below 23,250
items.description: VK Vijayakumar said market headwinds are getting stronger with escalation in the West Asia conflict. Other than elevated crude oil prices, the rise in bond yields is also keeping risk appetite subdued

items.title: Foreign investors may rejig allocation to Indian financials: Jefferies
items.description: Beyond the core earnings trajectory, clarity on the tenure and succession plans of chief executives at large financial institutions will also be important for the sector, analysts said.

items.title: Stock market holiday: Are BSE, NSE closed on Sept 14 for Ganesh Chaturthi?
items.description: The National Stock Exchange and the BSE will have no trading or settlement in stocks, derivatives, securities lending and borrowing segments on Monday.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Vi, OMCs, SBI, Texmaco Rail, PNB, HDFC Bank, YES Bank
items.description: Stocks to watch: Crude-linked shares, Vodafone Idea, SBI, Texmaco Rail, PNB, HDFC Bank, YES Bank, JSW Infra, Shankesh Jewellers, Gabriel India, among others, will be in focus today.

items.title: Adani Ports among 3 stock ideas for today by Bonanza's Kunal Kamble
items.description: Stocks to buy today: Kunal Kamble is bullish on three stocks, namely Adani Ports, Pine Labs and Aegis Vopak amid bullish signals on tech charts.

items.title: Ice cream stocks scoop up 85% gains from 2026 lows; can RIL roil the party?
items.description: India's per-capita ice cream consumption stands at approximately 1 to 1.6 litres per year, well below global averages of 2.5 to more than 15 litres in Western markets.
